data.name: exercises

columns.name: mechanics
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (mechanics IS NULL OR mechanics IN ('compound','isolation'))

columns.name: laterality
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (laterality IS NULL OR laterality IN ('bilateral','unilateral','alternating'))

columns.name: difficulty
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (difficulty IS NULL OR difficulty IN ('beginner','intermediate','advanced'))

columns.name: angle
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (angle IS NULL OR angle IN ('flat','incline','decline'))

columns.name: arm_position
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (arm_position IS NULL OR arm_position IN ('besideBody','behindBody','supportedInFront','overhead','flexed90','abducted90'))

columns.name: body_position
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (body_position IS NULL OR body_position IN ('standing','seated','lying','prone','bentOver','kneeling','halfKneeling','inclined'))

columns.name: grip
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (grip IS NULL OR grip IN ('pronated','supinated','neutral','mixed'))

columns.name: grip_width
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (grip_width IS NULL OR grip_width IN ('close','standard','wide'))

columns.name: knee_position
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (knee_position IS NULL OR knee_position IN ('straight','bent'))

columns.name: stance
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (stance IS NULL OR stance IN ('narrow','standard','wide','split'))

constraints: CHECK (source <> 'system' OR (provider_id IS NOT NULL AND revision IS NOT NULL))

data.name: plan_exercises
constraints: CHECK (reps_min IS NULL OR reps_min BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
CHECK (reps_max IS NULL OR reps_max BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
CHECK (reps_min IS NULL OR reps_min <= reps_max)
CHECK (target_load_kg IS NULL OR target_load_kg BETWEEN 0 AND 1000)
CHECK (rest_seconds IS NULL OR rest_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600)

data.name: session_sets
constraints: CHECK (reps IS NULL OR reps BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
CHECK (load_kg IS NULL OR load_kg BETWEEN 0 AND 1000)
CHECK (assistance_kg IS NULL OR assistance_kg BETWEEN 0 AND 1000)
CHECK (average_heart_rate IS NULL OR average_heart_rate BETWEEN 30 AND 250)
CHECK (energy_provenance IS NULL OR energy_provenance IN ('userEntered', 'estimated'))

CHECK (((exertion_scale IS NULL AND exertion_value IS NULL) OR (exertion_scale = 'rpe' AND exertion_value BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND exertion_value * 2 = CAST(exertion_value * 2 AS INTEGER)) OR (exertion_scale = 'rir' AND exertion_value BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND exertion_value = CAST(exertion_value AS INTEGER))) IS 1)
CHECK (rest_seconds IS NULL OR rest_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600)

columns.name: content_hash
columns.customConstraints: NOT NULL CHECK (length(content_hash) = 64 AND content_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

data.name: anatomy_nodes
constraints: CHECK (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id)

data.name: movement_patterns
constraints: CHECK (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id)

data.name: exercise_equipment

columns.name: role_override
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (role_override IS NULL OR role_override IN ('load','support'))

constraints: CHECK (role_override IS NULL OR (override_note IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(override_note, ' ' || char(9,10,13))) > 0))

data.name: migration_runs
constraints: CHECK (trigger_kind <> 'migration' OR (from_version IS NOT NULL AND to_version IS NOT NULL AND from_version < to_version))

data.name: migration_report_counts
constraints: CHECK ((dimension = 'category' AND code IN ('examined','migrated','preserved','quarantinedOrUnresolved','rejectedOrBlocked','warningForReview')) OR (dimension = 'disposition' AND code IN ('quarantined','cleared','retained','mapped','markerAdded','skipped','rejected','blocked','none','corrected')))

columns.name: block_reason
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (block_reason IS NULL OR block_reason IN ('noPrimaryTarget','unknownEquipment','invalidEquipment','invalidSecondaryTarget','invalidClassification','invalidAliases'))

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "measurements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "site" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "per100_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fibre_g" REAL NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_key" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_servings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES foods (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_log_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fibre_g" REAL NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_meal" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meal_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "saved_meal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES saved_meals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fibre_g" REAL NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "portions" REAL NOT NULL, "prep_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "cook_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "storage" TEXT NULL, "freezing" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "reheating" TEXT NULL, "favourite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favourite" IN (0, 1)), "prep_steps_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "cook_steps_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "total_weight_g" REAL NULL, "portion_weight_g" REAL NULL, "declared_kcal" REAL NULL, "declared_protein_g" REAL NULL, "declared_carbs_g" REAL NULL, "declared_fat_g" REAL NULL, "declared_fibre_g" REAL NULL, "nutrition_note" TEXT NULL, "ingredient_notes_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_ingredients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "kcal" REAL NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fibre_g" REAL NULL, "provenance" TEXT NULL, "serving_label" TEXT NULL, "serving_count" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_substitutes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_ingredient_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipe_ingredients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fibre_g" REAL NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_plan_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "eaten_entry_id" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prep_batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "prepared_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "portions_made" REAL NOT NULL, "portions_remaining" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("portions_remaining" >= 0.0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_providers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "licence" TEXT NOT NULL, "attribution" TEXT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "aliases_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "search_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "copied_from_id" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('system','user','imported')), "provider_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES content_providers (id), "revision" INTEGER CHECK (revision IS NULL OR revision >= 1), "mechanics" TEXT CHECK (mechanics IS NULL OR mechanics IN ('compound','isolation')), "laterality" TEXT CHECK (laterality IS NULL OR laterality IN ('bilateral','unilateral','alternating')), "difficulty" TEXT CHECK (difficulty IS NULL OR difficulty IN ('beginner','intermediate','advanced')), "retired_at" TEXT NULL, "angle" TEXT CHECK (angle IS NULL OR angle IN ('flat','incline','decline')), "arm_position" TEXT CHECK (arm_position IS NULL OR arm_position IN ('besideBody','behindBody','supportedInFront','overhead','flexed90','abducted90')), "body_position" TEXT CHECK (body_position IS NULL OR body_position IN ('standing','seated','lying','prone','bentOver','kneeling','halfKneeling','inclined')), "grip" TEXT CHECK (grip IS NULL OR grip IN ('pronated','supinated','neutral','mixed')), "grip_width" TEXT CHECK (grip_width IS NULL OR grip_width IN ('close','standard','wide')), "knee_position" TEXT CHECK (knee_position IS NULL OR knee_position IN ('straight','bent')), "stance" TEXT CHECK (stance IS NULL OR stance IN ('narrow','standard','wide','split')), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (source <> 'system' OR (provider_id IS NOT NULL AND revision IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "split" TEXT NULL, "scheduled_weekdays_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_plans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps_min" INTEGER NULL, "reps_max" INTEGER NULL, "target_load_kg" REAL NULL, "target_duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "target_metres" REAL NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sort_order >= 0), CHECK (target_sets BETWEEN 1 AND 20), CHECK (reps_min IS NULL OR reps_min BETWEEN 1 AND 100), CHECK (reps_max IS NULL OR reps_max BETWEEN 1 AND 100), CHECK ((reps_min IS NULL) = (reps_max IS NULL)), CHECK (reps_min IS NULL OR reps_min <= reps_max), CHECK (target_load_kg IS NULL OR target_load_kg BETWEEN 0 AND 1000), CHECK (target_duration_sec IS NULL OR target_duration_sec > 0), CHECK (target_metres IS NULL OR target_metres > 0), CHECK (rest_seconds IS NULL OR rest_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (position >= 0), CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 4000));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "set_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "load_kg" REAL NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "assistance_kg" REAL NULL, "duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "metres" REAL NULL, "average_heart_rate" INTEGER NULL, "energy_kcal" REAL NULL, "energy_provenance" TEXT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "exertion_scale" TEXT NULL, "exertion_value" REAL NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "set_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'working' CHECK (set_kind IN ('warmUp', 'working', 'failure')), "session_exercise_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES session_exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (reps IS NULL OR reps BETWEEN 1 AND 100), CHECK (load_kg IS NULL OR load_kg BETWEEN 0 AND 1000), CHECK (assistance_kg IS NULL OR assistance_kg BETWEEN 0 AND 1000), CHECK (duration_sec IS NULL OR duration_sec > 0), CHECK (metres IS NULL OR metres > 0), CHECK (average_heart_rate IS NULL OR average_heart_rate BETWEEN 30 AND 250), CHECK (energy_kcal IS NULL OR energy_kcal >= 0), CHECK (energy_provenance IS NULL OR energy_provenance IN ('userEntered', 'estimated')), CHECK ((energy_kcal IS NULL) = (energy_provenance IS NULL)), CHECK (((exertion_scale IS NULL AND exertion_value IS NULL) OR (exertion_scale = 'rpe' AND exertion_value BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND exertion_value * 2 = CAST(exertion_value * 2 AS INTEGER)) OR (exertion_scale = 'rir' AND exertion_value BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND exertion_value = CAST(exertion_value AS INTEGER))) IS 1), CHECK (rest_seconds IS NULL OR rest_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_workouts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (origin IN ('date', 'weekday', 'split')), CHECK (status IN ('planned', 'skipped', 'done')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "training_splits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "cycle_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (cycle_days BETWEEN 1 AND 14));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "split_days" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "split_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES training_splits (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "day_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (day_index BETWEEN 0 AND 13), UNIQUE (split_id, day_index));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_quarantine" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "quarantined_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "site" TEXT NULL, "target" REAL NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalogue_releases" ("provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_providers (id), "release" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("release" >= 1), "applied_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "applied_at_source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(applied_at_source) > 0), "content_hash_algorithm" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (content_hash_algorithm IN ('sha256')), "content_hash_encoding" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (content_hash_encoding IN ('hex-lower')), "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(content_hash) = 64 AND content_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), "inserted" INTEGER CHECK (inserted IS NULL OR inserted >= 0), "updated" INTEGER CHECK (updated IS NULL OR updated >= 0), "retired" INTEGER CHECK (retired IS NULL OR retired >= 0), "app_version" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("provider_id", "release"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "anatomy_nodes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES anatomy_nodes (id), "level" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (level BETWEEN 1 AND 4), "non_anatomical" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("non_anatomical" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_providers (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((level = 1) = (parent_id IS NULL)), CHECK (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id), CHECK (non_anatomical = 0 OR level = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movement_patterns" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES movement_patterns (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_providers (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "equipment_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "default_role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (default_role IN ('load','support','cardio','implement')), "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_providers (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reference_labels" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "locale" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kind", "id", "locale"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_targets" ("exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES anatomy_nodes (id), "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('primary','secondary')), "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("exercise_id", "node_id"), UNIQUE (exercise_id, ordinal));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_patterns" ("exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "pattern_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES movement_patterns (id), "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("exercise_id", "pattern_id"), UNIQUE (exercise_id, ordinal));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_equipment" ("exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "equipment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment_items (id), "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), "role_override" TEXT CHECK (role_override IS NULL OR role_override IN ('load','support')), "override_note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("exercise_id", "equipment_id"), UNIQUE (exercise_id, ordinal), CHECK (role_override IS NULL OR (override_note IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(override_note, ' ' || char(9,10,13))) > 0)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_names" ("exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "locale" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (locale <> 'en-GB'), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "aliases_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("exercise_id", "locale"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_user_state" ("exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "favourite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favourite" IN (0, 1)), "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)), "last_used_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("exercise_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_blocks" ("exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('noPrimaryTarget','unknownEquipment','invalidEquipment','invalidSecondaryTarget','invalidClassification','invalidAliases')), "original_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "blocked_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolved_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("exercise_id", "reason"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "migration_runs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trigger_kind IN ('migration','restore','integrityCheck','catalogueUpdate','userCorrection')), "from_version" INTEGER NULL, "to_version" INTEGER NULL, "generated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "app_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "provenance_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provenance_kind IN ('device','backup')), "provenance_source" TEXT NOT NULL, "merged_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (trigger_kind <> 'migration' OR (from_version IS NOT NULL AND to_version IS NOT NULL AND from_version < to_version)), CHECK ((provenance_kind = 'backup') = (merged_at IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "migration_report_counts" ("run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES migration_runs (id), "source_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "dimension" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (dimension IN ('category','disposition')), "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_count" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (record_count >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("run_id", "source_table", "dimension", "code"), CHECK ((dimension = 'category' AND code IN ('examined','migrated','preserved','quarantinedOrUnresolved','rejectedOrBlocked','warningForReview')) OR (dimension = 'disposition' AND code IN ('quarantined','cleared','retained','mapped','markerAdded','skipped','rejected','blocked','none','corrected'))));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "migration_report_entries" ("event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES migration_runs (id), "source_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NULL, "field" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER CHECK (position IS NULL OR position >= 0), "original_value" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(original_value)), "resulting_value" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(resulting_value)), "element" TEXT CHECK (element IS NULL OR json_valid(element)), "disposition" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (disposition IN ('quarantined','cleared','retained','mapped','markerAdded','skipped','rejected','blocked','none','corrected')), "block_reason" TEXT CHECK (block_reason IS NULL OR block_reason IN ('noPrimaryTarget','unknownEquipment','invalidEquipment','invalidSecondaryTarget','invalidClassification','invalidAliases')), "rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('migrated','preserved','quarantinedOrUnresolved','rejectedOrBlocked','warningForReview')), "quarantine_id" INTEGER NULL, "acknowledged_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_id"), CHECK ((disposition = 'blocked') = (block_reason IS NOT NULL)));
CREATE INDEX idx_measurements_site_recorded ON measurements (site, recorded_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_foods_barcode ON foods (barcode)
CREATE INDEX idx_foods_search_key ON foods (search_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_food_servings_food ON food_servings (food_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_food_log_day ON food_log_entries (day)
CREATE INDEX idx_saved_meal_items_meal ON saved_meal_items (saved_meal_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_recipe_ingredients_recipe ON recipe_ingredients (recipe_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_recipe_substitutes_ingredient ON recipe_substitutes (recipe_ingredient_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_meal_plan_items_day ON meal_plan_items (day)
CREATE INDEX idx_prep_batches_recipe ON prep_batches (recipe_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_plan_exercises_plan ON plan_exercises (plan_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_workout_sessions_started ON workout_sessions (started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_exercises_session ON session_exercises (session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_sets_session ON session_sets (session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_sets_exercise ON session_sets (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_sets_entry ON session_sets (session_exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_scheduled_workouts_day ON scheduled_workouts (day)
CREATE INDEX idx_split_days_split ON split_days (split_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_exercise_targets_node ON exercise_targets (node_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_exercise_patterns_pattern ON exercise_patterns (pattern_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_exercise_equipment_equipment ON exercise_equipment (equipment_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_migration_report_entries_run ON migration_report_entries (run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_migration_report_entries_record ON migration_report_entries (source_table, record_id)
